summaryZh: Banghart 实验室研究神经调节物质如何参与哺乳动物中枢神经系统的疼痛调控，重点是神经肽信号机制。团队结合电生理、光学和行为方法，并自主开发操控脑内神经化学信号的分子工具。
researchQuestions: 神经调质如何参与哺乳动物中枢神经系统的痛觉调节？

evidence.quote: The Banghart Lab seeks to understand how neuromodulators contribute to pain modulation in the mammalian central nervous system, with an focus on mechanisms governing neuropeptide signaling. Our multidisciplinary approach relies on electrophysiological, optical, and behavioral methods along with in-house development of molecular tools for manipulating neurochemical signaling in the brain.

The Banghart Lab seeks to understand how neuromodulators contribute to pain modulation in the mammalian central nervous system, with an focus on mechanisms governing neuropeptide signaling. Our multidisciplinary approach relies on electrophysiological, optical, and behavioral methods along with in-house development of molecular tools for manipulating neurochemical signaling in the brain.
